info.title: Planetary Explorer API
info.description: Mars landing-site environmental profiles, explainable suitability scoring, Earth analog matching and citation-backed scientific explanations. Scores are relative decision-support indices under documented assumptions, not safety certifications.

get.description:
The scoring spec's default criteria, weights and hard constraints, so the
frontend can initialise its sliders from the backend rather than hard-coding.

post.description:
Free-text objective -> PROPOSED weights for the existing criteria, with
rationale, trade-offs, unsupported needs and clarifying questions. The
proposal is validated deterministically; hard constraints and thresholds
are never exposed to free text.

Objective-aware guidance after a priority change: effective influence
before/after, de-emphasised factors, rank deltas and missing data, all
computed by the scoring engine; a model may only phrase them.

Body-aware analog ranking: every candidate on one body ranked against a
reference on the other, on a common positive-weight feature basis. The
pairwise maths is the same as /analogs/match (unchanged).

One-at-a-time weight sweep around the applied mission for one focus site.
Every point is re-scored by scoring_engine.evaluate + ranking_engine.rank.

get.description:
Earth, Mars and Moon locations, original measurements and body references.

No cross-body landing score is computed by this endpoint.

client_request_id.title: Client Request Id
client_request_id.description: Echoed back so the client can drop stale responses

results.title: Results

geographic_relevance.title: Geographic Relevance
geographic_relevance.description: site ids / regions this chunk is about

score.title: Score
score.description: retrieval score; higher is more relevant

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: Verbatim excerpts from the source that carry the fact's numbers

url.title: Url
url.description: DOI or official NASA link to the source

EvidenceCitation.title: EvidenceCitation
EvidenceCitation.description:
One curated research finding (data/evidence). `fact` is the display line;
every number in it appears in `quotes`, copied verbatim from the source.

question.title: Question
question.description: Optional focus question; treated as a hint, never as instructions

objective.title: Objective
objective.description: The applied mission objective, so digests can say why a source matters to it; untrusted text

half_width_deg.title: Half Width Deg
half_width_deg.description: Half-width of a square footprint, degrees

approx_width_km.title: Approx Width Km
approx_width_km.description: Footprint width in km at this latitude

GeographicFootprint.title: GeographicFootprint
GeographicFootprint.description:
The area a measurement summarises. A site is a footprint, not a point.

Mars coordinates are planetocentric latitude and east-positive longitude on
the IAU2000 Mars reference (MOLA MEGDR convention). Earth coordinates are
WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Both store longitude in the -180..180 convention so the
frontend can use one formula for marker placement.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Short objective-aware guidance; phrased by the model or by rules, numbers from the scoring engine only

HardConstraint.title: HardConstraint
HardConstraint.description:
A mandatory requirement. A site failing one is ineligible whatever its score.
Default thresholds are documented assumptions, not universal requirements.

source.title: Source
source.description: How the bounds were established, e.g. 'WMTS tile grid, zoom 11'

ImageBounds.title: ImageBounds
ImageBounds.description:
Geographic extent, east-positive degrees, -180..180. Only present when
the extent is known from the tiling scheme or a georeferenced product.

local_asset.title: Local Asset
local_asset.description: Cached copy under data/imagery/assets, served by the API

acquisition_date.title: Acquisition Date
acquisition_date.description: ISO date the data was ACQUIRED; null if not verified

release_date.title: Release Date
release_date.description: Date the source published the product; not an acquisition date

spatial_resolution_m_per_px.title: Spatial Resolution M Per Px
spatial_resolution_m_per_px.description: Ground sampling of THIS asset if known

coverage_evidence.title: Coverage Evidence
coverage_evidence.description: Why we believe this image covers the stated location

distance_from_site_km.title: Distance From Site Km
distance_from_site_km.description: Approximate offset of the scene centre from the candidate point, if known

relevance.title: Relevance
relevance.description: Human-readable relevance and caveat shown beside the image

appearance_note.title: Appearance Note
appearance_note.description: Processing / colour caveats, e.g. stretched or false colour

objective.title: Objective
objective.description: Free text; treated as untrusted data

current_weights.title: Current Weights
current_weights.description: Slider state to start from; null = scoring spec defaults

excluded_criteria.title: Excluded Criteria
excluded_criteria.description: Criteria the client knows are unscorable (no data); forced to 0

use_llm.title: Use Llm
use_llm.description: False = the fast keyword reading only (used for the app's startup default)

objective_hash.title: Objective Hash
objective_hash.description: Stable hash of the interpreted text; the client uses it to avoid stale 'interpreted' labels

tradeoffs.title: Tradeoffs
tradeoffs.description: Explicit 'X over Y' or negations found in the text

unsupported_needs.title: Unsupported Needs
unsupported_needs.description: Goals the landing-phase model cannot optimise

confidence_note.title: Confidence Note
confidence_note.description: What the confidence refers to: the reading of the text, never the suitability science

validation_notes.title: Validation Notes
validation_notes.description: Deterministic corrections applied to the proposal

mission_profile.title: Mission Profile
mission_profile.description: Mission type read from the text; selects which research applies

earth_suggestions.title: Earth Suggestions
earth_suggestions.description: Earth field-test site priorities from the same text (slope, relief)

analog_check.description: Earth <-> Mars cross-reference used for the priorities

constraint_evidence.title: Constraint Evidence
constraint_evidence.description: Research behind each hard constraint, by constraint_id

task_interpretation.description: Task / body / reference reading; additive to the landing-weight proposal

weights.title: Weights
weights.description: Override analog weights; null = spec defaults

planetary_differences.title: Planetary Differences
planetary_differences.description: Fundamental differences disclosed on every comparison

analog_reference_id.title: Analog Reference Id
analog_reference_id.description: Earth rover field test only: a Mars site id. When set, Earth sites are ranked by their analog similarity to that Mars site (the Explore analog calculation) instead of by the slope/relief targets.

retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At
retrieved_at.description: ISO date the data was fetched

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description:
Where a number came from. Every measurement carries a source_id that
resolves to one of these in the profile's `sources` map.

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: 1 = strongest match over the full ranked pool; null when unrankable

rank_color_position.title: Rank Color Position
rank_color_position.description: 0 = strongest ... 1 = weakest over the ranked pool; the client maps it onto its colour scale

coverage_fraction.title: Coverage Fraction
coverage_fraction.description: basis features comparable for this pair / basis features

evidence_source_id.title: Evidence Source Id
evidence_source_id.description: Source whose sentence states the text (status verified)

ReportedCondition.title: ReportedCondition
ReportedCondition.description:
A literature-reported condition text compiled by the workbook author.
Descriptive text only: never parsed into numbers and never scored. `text`
is null when the workbook found nothing (`not_found_in_sources`) or when its
only source is not on the approved list (`excluded_source`).

source_digests.title: Source Digests
source_digests.description: One per unique source URL, in evidence order

research_studies.title: Research Studies
research_studies.description: At most three structured study cards

evidence_gap.title: Evidence Gap
evidence_gap.description: Set when the corpus cannot support a useful proposal

delta_pp.title: Delta Pp
delta_pp.description: Requested change in the swept criterion's effective share, percentage points

share.title: Share
share.description: Realised normalised weight of the swept criterion under this scenario; null when it dropped out (weight 0)

weights.title: Weights
weights.description: Raw weights sent to the scoring engine for this scenario (active criteria sum to 100)

active_count.title: Active Count
active_count.description: Criteria actually scored under this scenario

focus_status.title: Focus Status
focus_status.description: null when the focus site is not in the candidate set

gap_to_alternative.title: Gap To Alternative
gap_to_alternative.description: focus score minus the leader's (or minus the runner-up's when the focus site leads); positive = focus ahead

site_ids.title: Site Ids
site_ids.description: Candidate subset; null = all sites. Must match the applied evaluation's set.

mission.description: The applied mission; it is read, never modified

focus_site_id.title: Focus Site Id
focus_site_id.description: The selected site whose rank and score are tracked across the sweep

range_pp.title: Range Pp
range_pp.description: Half-width of the sweep in percentage points of effective share (default +/-5)

step_pp.title: Step Pp
step_pp.description: Sweep resolution in percentage points; breakpoints are only located to this resolution

client_request_id.title: Client Request Id
client_request_id.description: Echoed back so the client can drop stale responses

active_criteria.title: Active Criteria
active_criteria.description: Criteria scored under the applied mission (weight > 0 and data on every candidate)

base_shares.title: Base Shares
base_shares.description: Effective normalised weights under the applied mission, active criteria only

base.description: The applied mission re-evaluated (delta 0); identical to POST /scoring/evaluate

assumption.title: Assumption
assumption.description: How the remaining share is redistributed, stated for display

too_few_active.title: Too Few Active
too_few_active.description: True when fewer than two criteria are active, so no one-at-a-time sweep is possible

base_share.title: Base Share
base_share.description: Effective share of this criterion under the applied mission

breakpoints.title: Breakpoints
breakpoints.description: Changes located between adjacent sweep points, to the sweep resolution only

focus_rank_stable.title: Focus Rank Stable
focus_rank_stable.description: True when the focus site's rank is the same at every point in the tested range

leader_stable.title: Leader Stable
leader_stable.description: True when the same site leads at every point in the tested range

note.title: Note
note.description: Plain reading of the sweep, always qualified as 'within the tested range'

heritage.title: Heritage
heritage.description: Mission that landed or selected this site, if any

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Terrain / geology keywords used by the analog engine

role.title: Role
role.description: How the workbook author classes the site; organises the site lists, never scored

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: The workbook author's note on the site

coordinates_approximate.title: Coordinates Approximate
coordinates_approximate.description: The workbook marks these coordinates as approximate

paired_earth_site_id.title: Paired Earth Site Id
paired_earth_site_id.description: The Earth location the workbook pairs with this site

reported_conditions.title: Reported Conditions
reported_conditions.description: Literature-reported condition texts; separate from measured profiles

earth_analogs.title: Earth Analogs
earth_analogs.description: Further Earth analogs the workbook lists for this site

SiteCandidate.title: SiteCandidate
SiteCandidate.description: An ambiguous or partial site mention the user must resolve with a selector; never a guessed coordinate.

missing_views.title: Missing Views
missing_views.description: Views with no verified imagery for this site

matched_text.title: Matched Text
matched_text.description: The words in the objective that named this site

SourceDigest.title: SourceDigest
SourceDigest.description:
One retrieved SOURCE (URL), summarised from its retrieved passages only.
`chunk_ids`/`citation_ids` are the exact passages the digest was written
from; grouping by source never remaps a claim to a different passage.

why_here.title: Why Here
why_here.description: Why this site (or this Earth analog) helps answer the question

motivating_citation_ids.title: Motivating Citation Ids
motivating_citation_ids.description: Exact [C#] handles whose passages motivate the card

cannot_infer.title: Cannot Infer
cannot_infer.description: What the study, the data or the analog similarity cannot establish

StudyCard.title: StudyCard
StudyCard.description:
A research application. A proposed study is a hypothesis to test, never
something this tool or anyone has shown; a documented campaign is a
historical analog programme recorded in the data files.

score.title: Score
score.description: Relative decision-support index, not a probability

rank.title: Rank
rank.description: 1 = best among eligible sites with status ok

direction_options.title: Direction Options
direction_options.description: Offered when the text does not settle the search direction

analog_suggestions.title: Analog Suggestions
analog_suggestions.description: Proposed analog-match preferences (separate from landing priorities)

TaskInterpretation.title: TaskInterpretation
TaskInterpretation.description:
What the objective asks for, separately from the landing-priority weights.
`focus_body` is where the user is looking for a location; `mission_destination`
is where the mission flies (a Mars mission can use Earth test sites).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why this weight was proposed; a preference, not a scientific finding

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.description: Research findings cited for this weight (0-3); empty = none in the registry applies

restriction.title: Restriction
restriction.description: Owner condition on how the source may be used

WorkbookSource.title: WorkbookSource
WorkbookSource.description: A source the owner approved for the workbook's condition texts.
